reviews_verbatim.author: Leah Jung
reviews_verbatim.text: Vander did an amazing job on my floors! He was professional, reliable, and really paid attention to detail. Everything turned out beautiful, and I’m so happy with the finished result. He made the whole process easy from start to finish. I would absolutely recommend Vander to anyone looking for quality flooring work! As a realtor I’ll be recommending him to clients as well 😊🙏

reviews_verbatim.author: Judy graham
reviews_verbatim.text:
Vander recently repaired our bathroom shower. He did an excellent job!

During the entire process, he explained
- what he was doing
- why he was doing it
- and what caused the problem.
I really appreciated being kept up to date and gaining an understanding of the process.

He also repaired several vinyl planks in our kitchen and again explained everything!

Highly recommend him!

reviews_verbatim.author: Nicole Johnson
reviews_verbatim.text: Vander did such an amazing job with our floors. His attention to detail and efficiency was remarkable. I would definitely recommend him to anyone who needs flooring work :)

reviews_verbatim.author: Timothy Aiken
reviews_verbatim.text: I rarely post anything, but I felt a personal obligation to right this review in regards to the outstanding work, time put in, and care that "Vander Braflat " of Greenyell-o Flooring Solutions, put into installing new hardwood floors and stairs in the bonus room at my home here in Jacksonville. He worked tirelessly each day taking measurements, and cutting wood flooring slats until each one fit perfectly in place, whether he was installing the floor and or stairs, it did not matter, he took his time, did it to the best of his ability and occasionally he would stop, ask my opinion and or seek input into what he was doing in regards to the whole installation process, and approximately how long it would take. At the end of the day, I couldn't be happier than a clown at the circus, fore Vander Braflat shows a love, and passion, it's clearly a labor of love, and it showed in the end result, which has me very happy and satisfied that Vander installed my new hardwood floors and stairs. The price from Greenyell-o Flooring Solutions, for the flooring / stairs instalation was fair and the craftsmanship and work from Vander was outstanding, and from this day forward, if and or whenever I need any kind of floor replacement or repair of an existing floor, I will look no further than Mr. Vander Braflat, and Greenyell-o Flooring Solutions. PS; Thank you Vander for a job well done.

reviews_verbatim.author: Jo Munch
reviews_verbatim.text:
We saw Vander’s work at a neighbor’s home and the great improvement inspired us to contact him and get an estimate to update two areas of our home. He responded very quickly and gave us an estimate that I thought was very reasonable, so we asked him to remove the tub in a guest bathroom and replace with a walk in shower. This involved moving the drain, demolishing the walls in the tub area, and replacing walls, tiling to ceiling, around a window, adding a tall niche with waterfall design of accent tile, and new tile flooring. The result is beautiful. I am very particular in my expectations and I am thrilled with the results. Vander definitely strives for perfection. His work is very precise and excellent. He always conferred with me to be sure he was meeting my expectations.

He also updated my screened in lanai by tiling over my pavers. First he skimmed over the pavers with a thin coating of concrete and then tiled the whole area.

What a difference that made to the look and feel of the area! We love it. It looks so clean now and looks like part of the house, rather than just an outdoor area.

He was also very consistent and considerate and left the work area clean each day. I would definitely recommend his work and I would contact his services again. He was also very pleasant to work with.

I took photos to post ( so you could see for yourself), but unfortunately, I don’t see how to post them.
